description: Fraunhofer CINES publishes a reference synthetic energy community for comparing alternative local-energy scenarios. The Fordatis repository identifies the CINES-REC-CITY ZIP archive, released in September 2025 under CC BY 4.0 for free access. The accompanying article describes a German district with seventy apartments, seventeen electric vehicles and heat-pump operation, supplied as fifteen-minute CSV profiles for one year. These coordinated loads can benchmark energy-sharing, demand-flexibility and grid-impact simulations using consistent underlying behaviour. They are generated profiles, not measured household records, and their assumed buildings, mobility and technologies mean that coverage is limited to the documented community design. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
